title: Brent crude oil crosses $118 a barrel as Ukraine conflict disrupts global supplies
summary: Global oil benchmark Brent crude rose above $118 per barrel for the first time since 2013, triggering concerns over energy import costs across Asia.

title: Indian aviation fuel prices hiked to record high; IndiGo operating margins under pressure
summary: State-run oil marketing companies increased aviation turbine fuel (ATF) by 3.3% tracking international crude spikes, with fuel costs now representing 40% of airline expenses.

title: Rupee drops to fresh low against US dollar as expanding crude import bill weighs
summary: The Indian rupee fell to 76.96 per USD as foreign portfolio investors sold equities and crude oil surges widened the nation trade and current account deficits.

title: Paint and chemical stocks slide: Asian Paints slips 4% on crude-derivative input inflation
summary: Shares of Asian Paints and Berger Paints declined sharply as raw material costs for titanium dioxide, solvents, and phthalic anhydride rose in tandem with crude.

title: ONGC surges 5% as upstream crude realizations surge above $100 per barrel
summary: State-owned explorer ONGC rallied on heavy trading volume as higher crude benchmark prices directly improve upstream gross revenues and exploration cash flows.

title: RBI faces inflation headache as imported energy prices threaten to breach 6% CPI ceiling
summary: Economists expect headline CPI inflation to remain elevated above the Reserve Bank of India upper tolerance limit of 6%, increasing odds of unscheduled monetary tightening.
